clauses.clause: sec. 1: delegates to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget the President's authority to allocate 'Expenses of Management Improvement' funds (68 Stat. 274 or any reenactment) to executive agencies
sec. 2: the Director shall report to the President from time to time on activities funded by the allocations and exercise direction and control over them

propositions.claim: EO 10559 was printed in the Federal Register of September 11, 1954, signed September 8, 1954.
propositions.quote: EXECUTIVE ORDER 10559

propositions.claim: Sec. 1 delegates the President's authority under the management improvement appropriation to the Budget Director.
propositions.quote: is hereby authorized and empowered to exercise the authority vested in the President by the paragraph appearing under the heading "Expenses of Management Improvement"

propositions.claim: Sec. 1 extends to reenactments of the appropriation, so it did not expire with the fiscal year 1955 act.
propositions.quote: or by any reenactment of the provisions of such paragraph in the same or in a different amount of funds

propositions.claim: Sec. 2 requires the Director to report to the President and to direct the funded activities.
propositions.quote: shall, consonant with law, exercise such direction and control with respect to the said activities as he shall deem appropriate.

propositions.claim: EO 11230 Sec. 2(2) supersedes the whole of EO 10559 by name.
propositions.quote: The following are hereby superseded : ... (2) Executive Order No. 10559 of September 8, 1954.

propositions.claim: EO 11230 is dated June 28, 1965 and was printed at 30 FR 8447-8450 (July 2, 1965).
propositions.quote: T he  W hite  House, June 28, 1965. [F.R. Doc. 65-7017 ; Filed, June 30, 1965 ; 1:24  p.m.]

propositions.claim: EO 11230 Sec. 1(23) re-delegates the same allocation authority under the 1965 appropriation, replacing EO 10559 sec. 1.
propositions.quote: to allocate to any agency or office o f the executive branch (including the Bureau o f the Budget) funds appropriated by that paragraph

propositions.claim: EO 11230 Sec. 1(23) restates the reporting and control duty, replacing EO 10559 sec. 2.
propositions.quote: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall from time to time report to the President concerning activities carried on by executive agencies

propositions.claim: EO 11230 Sec. 4 keeps prior actions taken under the superseded orders in effect, but does not continue the superseded orders themselves.
propositions.quote: shall, except as they may be incon­sistent with the provisions of this Order, remain in effect until amended, modified, or revoked

propositions.claim: The National Archives (OFR) Executive Orders Disposition Table for 1954 lists EO 10559 (19 FR 5879, September 11, 1954) as superseded by EO 11230. Corroboration only; the ending rests on p5.
propositions.quote: Superseded by: EO 11230, June 28, 1965

review.conclusion_reason: The express named supersession in EO 11230 section 2(2), signed June 28, 1965, supports the ending of both operative clauses and the separate formal supersession conclusion. Section 4 preserves prior implementing actions, not EO 10559 itself.

verdicts.reason: The held official-printing OCR identifies EO 10559, the September 11, 1954 issue, page 5879, and the September 8, 1954 signature date.
Section 1 expressly authorizes the Budget Director to exercise the President's allocation authority under the specified appropriation.
Section 1 expressly includes 'any reenactment' in the same or a different amount; its delegation is not limited to the original fiscal-year appropriation.
Section 2 contains both the periodic reporting requirement and the quoted direction-and-control duty.
EO 11230 section 2 states 'The following are hereby superseded' and item (2) names 'Executive Order No. 10559 of September 8, 1954' without qualification.
The held text gives June 28, 1965 as the signature date; its source metadata and printed page headers support 30 FR 8447–8450, July 2, 1965.
EO 11230 section 1(23) delegates allocation authority under the Executive Office Appropriation Act 1965 and reenactments, matching the function formerly delegated by EO 10559 section 1.
Section 1(23) expressly repeats both reporting and direction-and-control duties for activities funded under that paragraph.
Section 4 preserves prior actions in force, including regulations, subject to stated exceptions and termination; section 2 expressly supersedes the named orders themselves.

The supplied slice reproduces the claimed OFR note, but its API URL is truncated and the underlying source was not opened. A finding-aid quotation alone does not independently verify that attribution.
